info.name: DTS Practice Service - Auto Test
info.description:
# DTS Practice Service - Postman Collection

Automation test cho Practice Service (sat hach lai xe).

## Luong chay khuyen nghi
1. **[SETUP] Login lay Token** (bat buoc dau tien)
2. Questions - Get Stats
3. Questions - Get By Chapter
4. Questions - Get Critical
5. Questions - Get By ID
6. Exams - Start Exam (EXAM mode)
7. Exams - Get Session
8. Exams - Submit Answers (tu dong)
9. Exams - Finish Exam
10. Exams - Get Result
11. Exams - Start Practice (PRACTICE mode)
12. Exams - Submit Answer Practice (co giai thich)
13. Exams - Finish Practice
14. Exams - Get Exam History
15. Exams - Get Leaderboard

## ExamType hop le
A1, A2, B1, B2, C, D, E, F

## Automation
- Token tu dong lay tu Identity Service va luu vao accessToken
- examId tu dong luu sau khi Start Exam
- questionId tu dong lay tu exam session
- Answer tu dong chon 'A' (khong can nhap tay)
